messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Where is the data stored when I run a shiny application?
parts: It all depends on how you are running your app. If you're calling shiny::runApp from your R session or hitting the "Run App" button in RStudio, then everything is run locally on your machine--we don't send anything to our servers.
